observations: Vintage Singer sewing machine in cream and beige.
Brand 'SINGER' is visible on the top right of the machine.
The machine is sitting on a matching cream-colored plastic base.
A large circular dial on the right side is used for stitch length and width.
The needle and presser foot appear to be in good condition.
The machine is shown in a static, indoor setting with a plain background.
No power cord, light bulb, or accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and running through all stitch settings.

risks.risk: The light bulb may be burnt out or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the light bulb and the machine powered on.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing the power cord or other essential accessories.
risks.proof: A photo showing the power cord and all included accessories.

risks.risk: The internal mechanism (e.g., the bobbin case) may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken bobbin case

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and sewing through a piece of fabric.
Photo of the light bulb and the machine powered on.
Photo of the underside of the machine showing the bobbin case.
Photo of the power cord and all accessories.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
